**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The LD rule is satisfied at the **preferred** level — nothing in this agreement makes 551 FX IB Associates pay a liquidated sum or penalty.

What I checked and why nothing flags:

- **Fee/payment articles (Art. V, VII; p0050–p0058, p0068–p0089):** all Licensee payments are usage-based user fees per Monthly Notional Volume band, the $35,000 initial payment, taxes, and the $2,500/month support fee. No stipulated damages, no shortfall or minimum-volume penalty, no late-payment interest or default charge anywhere.
- **Term/termination (Art. IV, XIX–XXI; p0049, p0132–p0138):** on Licensor's termination for breach it retains only "the right to receive payments for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" — accrued actual fees, not acceleration of remaining contract value or an early-termination fee. Effect-of-termination (p0138) imposes only return/certification obligations, no exit payment.
- **Remedies (Art. XI, XIII, XXIII; p0126–p0131, p0142):** Article XXIII affirmatively bars termination damages of any kind against either party. Article XI gives Licensor equitable relief only, with no stipulated sum attached.
- **Not flagged as LD:** the >5% audit-discrepancy cost shift (p0064) and out-of-scope error work at standard rates (p0095) are cost reimbursement, not liquidated damages; the 15% rebate in shares (p0076) runs in our favour.

Note for the file (rationale only, not a deviation): the Licensee-side exposure in this contract sits in the indemnity (Art. XII) and the one-sided liability cap of one-half of amounts paid (p0130) — those belong to the INDEMNITY and LIABILITY rules, not LD, and I have not double-flagged them here.
